Sam: Morning — quick standup.
Sam: Yesterday: demoed Dedicated pilot to Rivermark, answered KMS questions; cleaned up PR #4519.
Sam: Blockers: Rivermark needs SSO/SCIM + EU data residency confirmation and HSM keywrap details from infra.
Sam: Today: follow up with infra, get legal quotes, prep canary for their pilot.
Marie: Thanks Sam. For SSO they specifically asked for Okta + group sync. Also want SCIM user provisioning docs.
Kiran: @InfraBot can we confirm whether EU data residency for Dedicated is possible in Q2? Any estimate?
InfraBot: deploy/infra-status: EU-region provisioning ETA depends on capacity — open ticket INF-8723. Current estimate: mid-May.
Olivia: Quick ask — can someone review my PR changing routing policy in `routing/service.py`? Link: https://git.company/pr/4521
Olivia: Small change, affects canary rollout and fallback to `tiny-quant` model. Need one +1 before I merge.
Josh: On Rivermark latency: they reported spikes ~p95 at 450ms. I grabbed traces, looks like batching spike. Pinging eng-runtime for a light touch.
Sam: Re: HSM: Rivermark wants keywrap proofs. Marie, can you list the exact artifacts they need (attestation, KMS flow diagrams)?
Marie: Yep — they'll want HSM attestation doc, key lifecycle diagram, and SOC2 section on key management. I'll assemble a short bundle by EOD.
Kiran: Also, customer asked about SSO SCIM mapping for groups -> product roles. Marie, can we mock a sample SCIM mapping? Olivia can include it in the onboarding doc.
Marie: Will do. I'll drop a sample JSON into the shared drive and link here.
InfraBot: ticket INF-8723 updated by @kiran: "Request EU Dedicated region timeline" — https://tickets.company/INF-8723 :eyes:
Sam: OK — plan for today: Marie assemble artifacts; Kiran coordinate with infra; Olivia merge after 1 review; Josh follow up on latency with eng-runtime. Ping here with any blockers. :thumbsup:
Marie: FYI — I may be OOO tomorrow afternoon, will handoff to @Josh if needed.
Josh: noted. I'll cover.
Olivia: I'll try to get a reviewer by noon. tagging @kiran for quick glance if free.
Kiran: can do after 9:30. Thanks.
Sam: thanks team — updating CRM entry for Rivermark with these asks. Leaving summary in the thread for audit.
